annotator: Codex single-agent visual inspection; no independent adjudication
protocol: Literal text and original-image boxes were frozen before any local OCR run on these four photographs. The annotator had implemented the pipeline and selected sources to exercise known weaknesses; this is unblinded development evaluation, not held-out accuracy. No OCR outputs, filenames, catalogue metadata, source-page transcriptions or arithmetic supplied unseen label truth.
scope: Four real photographs, 14 readable literal targets. Five targets have sufficiently explicit semantics for normalized structured scoring: one B-prefixed batch code, two printed rupee amounts and two unit prices. Seven date fragments and two unlabelled codes are literal-only targets. No legal, product-authenticity, medical, safety or package-completeness verdict is annotated. No net quantity is visible; do not derive it from the price ratio.
coordinates: Approximate axis-aligned [left,top,right,bottom] boxes in the original decoded image pixel grid. Originals retained with no local modification; plain crop files are visual inspection aids only and not additional evaluation inputs.
matching: Literal case and whitespace may be normalized; punctuation and every digit remain material. A spatially overlapping selected line or same-pass candidate must contain the complete target literal with token boundaries. Structured comparisons require the exact annotated value and source overlap; price currency and unit-price basis must also match. Unknown or semantically ambiguous fields are excluded, not scored as correctly absent.
